description: Methods of data acquisition, study and analysis required for solving oceanographic problems. Includes a field component held at Bamfield Marine Sciences Centre. Focus is on planning, implementing and analyzing a field data set, elucidating the biological, chemical, geological and physical dynamics of coastal waters.

supplementalNotes:
• Normally offered in summer session.
  • Permission to register in this course is required by the School. Applications for permission to register are normally due in Fall term for summer field schools.
  • See the School website (seos.uvic.ca) or contact the School office (seos@uvic.ca) for application due date and field school dates.
  • If oversubscribed, priority will be given to students declared in a program that requires the course, and to students nearest to graduation.
  • A field school fee applies to this course, in addition to tuition fees.
